description: Log in (creating the account on first use, logging back into it on every later call with the same device_id) with no email/password, exactly like POST /v1/guest (docs/protocol.md §1). Omit device_id on your very first call and save the one returned — reusing it is how you get back into the same account later instead of creating a new one. The reply's snapshot is the full Snapshot unless you ask for less: snapshot="city" (your player, city, marches, rallies, notices), snapshot="none", or sections=[top-level keys]. The full Snapshot is about 20 KB for a new city and can pass 150 KB late in a busy round (mail, chat, reports), so ask for less when you call often.

agent_pass.description: optional agent pass (AGENT-XXXX-XXXX) from the player who invited you to play beside them: you start in their kingdom as their agent

device_id.description: stable id to reuse across sessions to return to the same account; omit on first use and a fresh one is generated and returned

invite.description: optional invite code, when another player invited you: you start in their kingdom when it is open

sections.description: optional list of the Snapshot's top-level keys to return, overriding snapshot; now is always included. "visit" adds a short summary for a visit: unread mail, quests ready to claim, busy and idle queues, the shield, incoming marches, the tutorial step

snapshot.description: how much of the Snapshot to return: full (default) the whole Snapshot; city only now, config_hash, map_size, player, city, marches, rallies and notices; none no snapshot

name: guest_login

snapshot.description: The Snapshot (docs/protocol.md §5), cut down as the snapshot/sections arguments asked. Every key is described in docs/protocol.md §5 (the agentickingdoms://docs/protocol resource).

title: Play as a guest
